newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station at noon on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Fifty Lithuanian students staged a rally in Helsinki ahead of the summit meeting between Russian President Boris Yeltsin and his American counterpart Bill Clinton. The students asked the presidents not to sacrifice the future of the Baltic states.

- The Lithuanian Liberal Union says it agrees with the government's plans to sell the country's biggest state enterprises but opposes its proposal to use the proceeds to compensate depositors who lost their savings in 1990-91. The Union says the money should be used to radically restructure the country's pension system.
